title: Porus (Raja Puru)
hook: Porus (Raja Puru): Sikandar se Hydaspes ka yuddh
exam_points: Hydaspes (Jhelum) ka yuddh 326 BCE mein Sikandar aur Porus ke beech hua.
Haar ke baad bhi Sikandar ne Porus ka rajya wapas lauta diya aur use apna sahyogi banaya.
Sikandar ne yuddh ke baad Bucephala aur Nicaea nagar basaye.
